## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals: Energy/Industrials/Materials ABOVE TREND while Technology and Financials show broad weakness; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Energy) and notable megacap divergence.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%). Industrials strong: BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +10.90%), CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +2.74%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -3.48%), while NVDA remains ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%). Financials soft/mixed with banks in CORRECTION: JPM CORRECTION (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%), V CORRECTION (1W: -2.44% | 1M: +5.11%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: INTC RECOVERY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%), NKE RECOVERY (1W: +5.47% | 1M: -2.54%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.34% | 1M: +8.30%). Leadership concentrated: Narrow (3/5 Energy) — watch concentration risk.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -9.75% | 1M: +2.06%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%), ADBE CORRECTION (1W: -5.58% | 1M: +3.25%), CRM CORRECTION (1W: -4.39% | 1M: +8.23%), IBM BELOW TREND (1W: -4.29% | 1M: -3.41%). Weakness concentrated in Technology and select high-multiple names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: INTC RECOVERY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.95% | 1M: +1.54%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%). Major divergence present (≥3 large caps showing 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical, watch for trend breaks rather than broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed to negative with leadership bifurcated: NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%), AMD ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +3.82%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -1.02% | 1M: -5.30%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.09% | 1M: -3.48%). Sector 1W: -1.20% | 19 stocks — internal rotation and caution on tech exposure.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Mixed/correcting: large-cap payments and banks showing short-term pullbacks (JPM CORRECTION 1W: -1.12% | 1M: +5.72%; V CORRECTION 1W: -2.44% | 1M: +5.11%; MA CORRECTION 1W: -2.82% | 1M: +3.15%). Sector 1W: -1.30% | 20 stocks — positive 1M breadth but 1W weakness suggests caution.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Neutral-to-positive on select names: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +4.35%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.31% | 1M: +3.27%), GILD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -1.22%). Sector 1W: -0.28% | 15 stocks — idiosyncratic opportunities, not broad defensive leadership.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Maintain balanced stance and favor cyclicals/value exposure given Energy/Industrials strength; favor XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +6.30%) and CAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.51% | 1M: +2.74%), and reduce exposure to select big-cap tech showing BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while watching megacap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) — news and price confirming; INTC RECOVERY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) — watch follow-through on strategic investor headlines. BEARISH: INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%) and GILD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -1.22%) — negative sentiment confirming price pressure.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +2.15%) — breadth concentrated and momentum intact. BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -1.12%) and Financials (1W: -1.30% | 1M: +6.55%) — watch for bank-led dispersion.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA ABOVE TREND for loss of 1W momentum (flip to CORRECTION if 1W turns meaningfully negative), AAPL BELOW TREND for persistent 1M weakness (continued below-trend risk), SLB ABOVE TREND for confirmation above recent breakout (sustained 1W strength).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
SLB (+60): SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%) — news (Aramco contract) confirming price strength. INTC (+55): INTC RECOVERY (1W: +8.90% | 1M: -9.41%) — strategic Nvidia interest aligns with 1W surge but 1M still weak (divergence). ADBE (+50): ADBE CORRECTION (1W: -5.58% | 1M: +3.25%) — bullish headlines but 1W weakness signals distribution risk.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
INTU (-50): INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.97%) — negative guidance and price confirming downward trend. GILD (-50): GILD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -1.22%) — pricing news aligns with underperformance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Energy and Industrials strength. SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.87% | 1M: +11.43%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +4.35%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +4.08%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major megacap divergence (INTC RECOVERY, JPM CORRECTION, TSLA CORRECTION) and mixed news-price signals (ADBE/NEM) — monitor for confirmation before shifting core positioning.
